datasets.name: Jilin-1 optical satellite imagery
datasets.verbatim: As shown in Fig. 5a, the imagery came from the Jilin-1 (0.5 m resolution, 62 scenes on August 5, 2024, UTC + 8) and Planet satellites (3 m resolution, 32 scenes from August 4–5, 2024, UTC + 8).

datasets.name: GSMaP_Gauge rainfall data
datasets.verbatim: Rainfall data were from the GSMaP_Gauge product, which provides a 30-min average rainfall intensity from 00:00 June 15 to 24:00 June 17, 2024 (UTC + 8), at a 0.1° × 0.1° spatial resolution.

methods.name: YOLOv8s-CatBoost-SHAP triplet framework
methods.summary: An integrated framework coupling YOLOv8s for automated landslide detection from optical imagery with a CatBoost machine learning model combined with SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) to quantify the nonlinear driving effects of environmental factors on landslide occurrence.

availability.author_statement: The data that support the findings of this study are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are not linked or provided, and the custom YOLOv8s-CatBoost-SHAP framework code is not available.
